root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc != NULL` after the local-document XPointer result is computed.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `xmlXIncludeLoadDoc()` resolves a local-document XPointer, it must materialize the replacement copy into `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` before returning to phase 3 instead of deferring the node-set object in `ctxt->incTab[nr]->xptr`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original leaves `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` null for local-document XPointer includes and caches the `xmlXPathObjectPtr` in `ctxt->incTab[nr]->xptr`, so phase 3 can free original document nodes before the later copy. The fixed original materializes `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` immediately and does not preserve a deferred local-document `xptr` for phase 3.

nodes.state: Phase 3 reaches the deferred local-document path and calls `xmlXIncludeCopyXPointer()` with the cached `ctxt->incTab[nr]->xptr` because `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` is still null.
The `XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE` replacement branch unlinks and frees the current include node with `xmlFreeNode(cur)` before the later deferred local-document copy finishes.
At `switch (set->nodeTab[i]->type)`, the deferred XPointer copy reads a node pointer from the cached node set that matches the earlier `xmlFreeNode(cur)` target.

edges.relation: The same deferred local-document `xmlXPathObjectPtr` cached in `ctxt->incTab[nr]->xptr` at `xmlXIncludeLoadDoc()` is later passed into `xmlXIncludeCopyXPointer()` from `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode()`.
The cached `ctxt->incTab[nr]->xptr` passed by `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode()` is the same `obj` consumed inside `xmlXIncludeCopyXPointer()` at the sink loop.
The node pointer freed earlier through `xmlFreeNode(cur)` is later re-read as `set->nodeTab[i]` when `xmlXIncludeCopyXPointer()` inspects the deferred node set.
